description: Machine-readable catalog of protocol error codes currently defined by the public Glomancy Protocol package.

codes.name: invalid_envelope
codes.description: The protocol envelope is malformed or violates required envelope-level structure.

codes.name: unsupported_version
codes.description: The supplied or negotiated wire protocol version is not supported by the receiving implementation.

codes.name: unknown_schema
codes.description: The message references a schema identifier that is not registered for the supported public protocol contract.

codes.name: unknown_message_kind
codes.description: The message kind is unknown to the receiving implementation and must fail closed.

codes.name: policy_denied
codes.description: Local policy rejected the requested protocol operation.

codes.name: message_too_large
codes.description: The message exceeds the public or locally enforced message-size limit.

codes.name: invalid_identifier
codes.description: A required protocol identifier does not satisfy the public identifier contract.

codes.name: internal
codes.description: An internal protocol-processing failure occurred that is not represented by a more specific public protocol error code.
